The symposium includes new research from Professor Carter, as well as from John Davis, Nerio Naldi and Eleonora Lattanzi, Bertram Schefold, Andres Lazzarini and Gabriel Brondino, and Lucia Morra. Volume 35B also features general research contributions from Masazumi Wakatabe, and co-authors Eugene Callahan and Andreas Hoffman. Mary Furner, Matthew Frye Jacobson, Scott Scheall, and Charles R. McCann, Jr. offer unique perspectives on Thomas C. Leonard's (2015) Illiberal Reformers: Race, Eugenics, and American Economics in the Progressive Era. Professor Leonard contributes a response essay.
